target.title: fix(googlechat): media downloads can grow unbounded without a size cap
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where direct callers of the Google Chat media download API could omit `maxBytes` and let a successful media response buffer through an uncapped `arrayBuffer()` call. The normal inbound attachment path already passes a configured cap, but the exported helper still had an uncapped fallback.

## Why This Change Was Made

Google Chat media downloads now use the existing 20 MiB Google Chat media default whenever callers do not provide a stricter cap. Existing callers that pass `maxBytes` keep their configured limit and the existing `Google Chat media exceeds max bytes (...)` error contract.

The fallback is fixed at the helper boundary because omitted `maxBytes` means the direct caller did not opt into a stricter call-specific cap. Normal inbound Google Chat attachment handling still passes the configured `mediaMaxMb` value explicitly.

## User Impact

Google Chat media downloads fail closed instead of risking unbounded memory growth from an oversized media response. Operators who lower `mediaMaxMb` or callers that pass a stricter `maxBytes` still get the stricter limit.

## Evidence

- Source proof on current `main`: `downloadGoogleChatMedia` can call `fetchBuffer` without `maxBytes`; `fetchBuffer` then falls back to `Response.arrayBuffer()` on successful responses.
- Local focused test: `OPENCLAW_HEAVY_CHECK_LOCK_SCOPE=worktree node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/googlechat/src/targets.test.ts -- --run` -> 1 file / 26 tests passed.
- Local format: `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check extensions/googlechat/src/api.ts extensions/googlechat/src/targets.test.ts` -> clean.
- Local lint: `OPENCLAW_HEAVY_CHECK_LOCK_SCOPE=worktree node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs extensions/googlechat/src/api.ts extensions/googlechat/src/targets.test.ts` -> clean.
- Testbox-through-Crabbox: `tbx_01kwec4jk538eagta0w1ey5wk0` / Actions run https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28503690600 ran the focused Google Chat target test and `check:changed` successfully (`exitCode=0`).
- Regression proof now includes a controlled loopback HTTP endpoint streaming a chunked 32 MiB response through the real `downloadGoogleChatMedia` helper path; omitted `maxBytes` rejects at the 20 MiB default, invokes the guard release, and stops before the full payload is sent. It also proves Content-Length fast-fail without body reads and preserves explicit `maxBytes: 10` overflow text/cancellation.
